name: plantuml
description: PlantUML Diagrams — Nextcloud frontend (Viewer handler, file actions, the editor and the README observer)

scripts.build: ENTRY=editor vite --mode production build && ENTRY=files vite --mode production build && ENTRY=readme vite --mode production build
scripts.dev: ENTRY=files vite --mode development build && ENTRY=editor vite --mode development build && ENTRY=readme vite --mode development build

comment: Three bundles, one per surface: dist/plantuml-files.js (Viewer handler, file actions, + New) and dist/plantuml-readme.js (the Text workspace observer) are single-file IIFEs, the sibling apps' shape; dist/plantuml-editor.js (CodeMirror split pane) is an ES module that imports each diagram type's profile from dist/chunks/ when a file needs it. One vite config, selected by ENTRY.
